name: pr-review-quiz
description: Evidence-backed pull request review, logical review units, inline findings, and a portable HTML walkthrough.

interface.shortDescription: Review PRs as evidence-backed logical units.
interface.longDescription: Reviews a frozen GitHub pull request with native agent passes, verifies findings against source, and renders a persistent keyboard-navigable HTML walkthrough.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $pr-review-quiz to review this pull request and build the HTML walkthrough. Keep the run read-only unless I explicitly ask to publish.
